items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Rosalind Academic Plan for free GPT-Rosalind access in US university labs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Rosalind學術計畫，美國大學實驗室可免費使用GPT-Rosalind
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan on October 15, offering eligible academic labs at U.S. universities up to 30 free ChatGPT Business Standard seats for up to 12 months. Approved labs can also receive access to GPT-Rosalind, its dedicated life-sciences model, subject to trusted-access review. Research data is not used for training by default, and the offer excludes API access.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月15日推出Rosalind學術計畫，符合資格的美國大學實驗室最多可獲30個ChatGPT Business Standard席次，最長12個月免費。經審核的實驗室還可存取專用生命科學模型GPT-Rosalind。預設不使用研究數據訓練模型，且不含API存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands specialized scientific access beyond enterprise customers and signals OpenAI’s interest in academic life-sciences workflows. The trusted-access requirement and U.S.-only scope limit immediate reach while addressing data-sensitivity concerns common in unpublished research.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將專業科學存取從企業客戶擴展到學術界，顯示OpenAI對生命科學工作流程的興趣。受信任存取要求與美國限定範圍限制了立即覆蓋範圍，同時回應未發表研究對資料敏感性的常見疑慮。
items_flat.quote: The new Rosalind Academic Plan helps scientific labs bring AI into the work of understanding biology, exploring ideas, and deciding what to test next—with sponsored access for eligible labs at U.S. universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 新的Rosalind學術計畫幫助科學實驗室將AI帶入理解生物學、探索想法與決定下一步測試的工作中——為符合資格的美國大學實驗室提供贊助存取。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic and Simons Foundation commit $15M to help mathematicians review AI results
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic與Simons基金會承諾1500萬美元協助數學家審核AI結果
items_flat.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a $15 million initiative in partnership with OpenAI and Anthropic to support workshops, conferences, and programs that help mathematicians evaluate, understand, and build on AI-generated mathematical results. OpenAI and Anthropic each committed $5 million plus model and compute access for foundation-supported researchers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Simons基金會宣布與OpenAI及Anthropic合作的1500萬美元倡議，支持工作坊、會議與計畫，協助數學家評估、理解並延伸AI生成的數學結果。OpenAI與Anthropic各承諾500萬美元，並為基金會支持的研究人員提供模型與運算資源。
items_flat.analysis_en: The initiative responds to the volume of AI-generated math results OpenAI released earlier in October, shifting focus from generation to verification and community standards. It is an early institutional step rather than a fully defined evaluation framework.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此倡議回應OpenAI十月初發布的大量AI生成數學結果，將焦點從生成轉向驗證與社群標準。這是早期制度性步驟，而非已完整定義的評估框架。
items_flat.quote: How can the math community forge the best path forward in the AI age? We're committing $15M to workshops and initiatives — plus free AI computing resources for foundation-supported researchers — through new partnerships with @AnthropicAI and @OpenAI
items_flat.quote_zh: 數學社群如何在AI時代找到最佳前進道路？我們透過與@AnthropicAI和@OpenAI的新合作，承諾1500萬美元用於工作坊與倡議——並為基金會支持的研究人員提供免費AI運算資源。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic grants METR employee-like access for independent risk evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic給予METR員工級存取權進行獨立風險評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it has onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space, and access to internal tools roughly on par with its own risk-assessment teams. METR will publish analyses of Anthropic’s risk levels, incidents, or practices; Anthropic cannot veto publication but may require redactions in narrow predefined categories such as customer data or model architecture.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布已為六名METR員工提供公司硬體、辦公空間與內部工具存取，水準大致與自家風險評估團隊相當。METR將發布對Anthropic風險等級、事件或實務的分析；Anthropic無法否決出版，但可要求在客戶資料或模型架構等狹窄預定義類別中進行刪減。
items_flat.analysis_en: Embedding external evaluators with publication rights that Anthropic cannot block is a concrete step toward external accountability after the White House Accord. The practical impact depends on the scope of redactions and whether other labs adopt similar access.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 嵌入擁有Anthropic無法阻擋出版權的外部評估者，是白宮協議後邁向外部問責的具體步驟。實際影響取決於刪減範圍，以及其他實驗室是否採納類似存取安排。
items_flat.quote: We've onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space, and access to internal tools and systems that are roughly on par with what our own risk assessment teams have access to.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已為六名METR員工提供公司硬體、辦公空間，以及大致與我們自家風險評估團隊相當的內部工具與系統存取權。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA releases open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for always-on agents
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA發布開源Nemotron 3.5 Super VL與Bolt模型，支援持續運行代理
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model (12B active) built for always-on agentic tasks including instruction following, tool use, multistep workflows, and visual document understanding. It also released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B for local 24GB systems; Bolt E4B is scheduled for October 23. Weights are available on Hugging Face with post-training support.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA發布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，一款開源1200億參數多模態模型（12B活躍），專為持續運行代理任務設計，包括指令遵循、工具使用、多步驟工作流程與視覺文件理解。同時發布適用於本地24GB系統的Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B；Bolt E4B預定10月23日推出。權重已於Hugging Face提供，並支援後訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open weights that organizations can post-train and run on their own infrastructure address demand for controllable, on-premises agents. Claims of matching larger models at one-fifth the parameters remain NVIDIA-reported and await broader independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 組織可後訓練並在自身基礎設施上運行的開源權重，回應了對可控本地代理的需求。以約五分之一參數達到較大模型表現的宣稱仍為NVIDIA所報告，有待更廣泛獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA今日發布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，一款開源1200億參數模型，為專業持續運行代理提供最快任務完成與最高準確度。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases open-weight Muse Spark Open, optimized for two Mac Studios
items_flat.title_zh: Meta發布開源權重Muse Spark Open，優化於兩台Mac Studio運行
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open on October 15, describing it as the most capable U.S. open-weight model to date. The 816B-parameter mixture-of-experts model (42B active) supports a 1M-token context and multimodal input; it is optimized to run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX and is available through multiple inference platforms and download sites under the Muse Model License.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於10月15日發布Muse Spark Open權重，稱其為迄今最有能力的美國開源權重模型。這款8160億參數混合專家模型（42B活躍）支援100萬token上下文與多模態輸入；優化於兩台Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio透過MLX運行，並可透過多個推論平台與下載站點取得，採用Muse模型授權。
items_flat.analysis_en: Local desktop deployment of a large open agentic model lowers the barrier for developers who prefer on-device control. Benchmark leadership is mixed—stronger on tool-use tasks in Meta’s comparisons, trailing some Chinese open models on coding—so practical value depends on the specific workflow.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 大型開源代理模型的本地桌面部署，降低了偏好裝置端控制的開發者門檻。基準領先地位參差不齊——在Meta比較中工具使用較強，編碼則落後部分中國開源模型——實際價值取決於具體工作流程。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re releasing the weights for Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weight model to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布Muse Spark Open的權重，這是迄今最有能力的美國開源權重模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 with new voices and better accents in ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI在ChatGPT推出GPT-Live-1.1，新增語音與改善口音
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and a mini version called GPT-Live-1.1 Quip in ChatGPT Voice, Codex, and dots. The update improves natural accents across languages and adds new voices for French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Mexican Spanish, plus Bubbie in English. It also uses a wider range of short phrases while searching and is coming to the API.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI正在ChatGPT Voice、Codex與dots中推出GPT-Live-1.1及其迷你版GPT-Live-1.1 Quip。更新改善跨語言自然口音，並新增法語、德語、印地語、日語、韓語與墨西哥西班牙語語音，以及英語的Bubbie。搜尋時使用更多短語，並即將進入API。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an incremental but practical improvement to real-time voice interaction rather than a new model family. Better multilingual accents and reduced awkward filler phrases matter for everyday usability, yet they do not change underlying model capability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對即時語音互動的增量但實用改進，而非新模型家族。更好的多語口音與減少尷尬填充短語對日常可用性重要，但未改變底層模型能力。
items_flat.quote: New voices. Better accents. And less "checking..." GPT-Live-1.1 brings these updates to Voice in ChatGPT, Codex, and dots
items_flat.quote_zh: 新語音。更好口音。以及更少「檢查中……」。GPT-Live-1.1將這些更新帶入ChatGPT、Codex與dots的語音功能。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for STEM and Conceptual Reasoning Fellowships
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放STEM與概念推理獎學金申請
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened applications for two new fellowships. STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic starting January 2027, working to improve Claude’s reasoning on specialized problems. The application deadline is October 28.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic開放兩項新獎學金申請。STEM獎學金（科學與工程）與概念推理獎學金（哲學、認知科學、經濟、政策與法律）將自2027年1月起在Anthropic工作四個月，協助改善Claude在專業問題上的推理。申請截止日期為10月28日。
items_flat.analysis_en: Expanding fellowship tracks beyond core AI-safety engineering to domain reasoning suggests Anthropic wants external expertise to improve Claude’s performance on specialized tasks. Impact will depend on how fellows’ work is integrated into model development.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將獎學金軌跡從核心AI安全工程擴展到領域推理，顯示Anthropic希望引入外部專業知識以改善Claude在專業任務上的表現。影響將取決於獎學金工作如何整合進模型開發。
items_flat.quote: Applications are now open for two new Anthropic Fellowships. STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic from January 2027
items_flat.quote_zh: 兩項新的Anthropic獎學金現已開放申請。STEM獎學金（科學與工程）與概念推理獎學金（哲學、認知科學、經濟、政策與法律）將自2027年1月起在Anthropic工作四個月。

meta.analysis_en: Local desktop deployment of a large open agentic model lowers the barrier for developers who prefer on-device control. Benchmark leadership is mixed—stronger on tool-use tasks in Meta’s comparisons, trailing some Chinese open models on coding—so practical value depends on the specific workflow.
meta.analysis_zh: 大型開源代理模型的本地桌面部署，降低了偏好裝置端控制的開發者門檻。基準領先地位參差不齊——在Meta比較中工具使用較強，編碼則落後部分中國開源模型——實際價值取決於具體工作流程。
meta.quote: Today, we’re releasing the weights for Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weight model to date.
meta.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布Muse Spark Open的權重，這是迄今最有能力的美國開源權重模型。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA releases open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for always-on agents
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA發布開源Nemotron 3.5 Super VL與Bolt模型，支援持續運行代理
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model (12B active) built for always-on agentic tasks including instruction following, tool use, multistep workflows, and visual document understanding. It also released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B for local 24GB systems; Bolt E4B is scheduled for October 23. Weights are available on Hugging Face with post-training support.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA發布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，一款開源1200億參數多模態模型（12B活躍），專為持續運行代理任務設計，包括指令遵循、工具使用、多步驟工作流程與視覺文件理解。同時發布適用於本地24GB系統的Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B；Bolt E4B預定10月23日推出。權重已於Hugging Face提供，並支援後訓練。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Open weights that organizations can post-train and run on their own infrastructure address demand for controllable, on-premises agents. Claims of matching larger models at one-fifth the parameters remain NVIDIA-reported and await broader independent verification.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 組織可後訓練並在自身基礎設施上運行的開源權重，回應了對可控本地代理的需求。以約五分之一參數達到較大模型表現的宣稱仍為NVIDIA所報告，有待更廣泛獨立驗證。
frontier_other.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
frontier_other.quote_zh: NVIDIA今日發布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，一款開源1200億參數模型，為專業持續運行代理提供最快任務完成與最高準確度。

brief_en: OpenAI expands specialized science access via Rosalind Academic Plan and joins a $15M math verification effort. Anthropic embeds METR evaluators with publication rights. NVIDIA and Meta ship open agentic models for local and always-on use. Voice updates roll out incrementally.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出Rosalind學術計畫擴大生命科學存取，並與Anthropic參與1500萬美元數學驗證倡議。Anthropic給予METR員工級獨立評估權。NVIDIA與Meta發布開源代理模型支援本地與持續運行。語音更新屬增量改進。
